messages:
maya: Heads-up — customer 'AtlasAI' has a queued request for 4 x A100 reservations in us-west-2 that never moved past 'billing verification'. They need capacity in ~36h. Can someone triage? :warning:
ryan: I see the queue entry (queue-id: q-9f3b). AWS account has a pending invoice hold flagged by billing-bot, that blocks auto-reserve. Pulling logs now.
sasha: If billing hold can't clear quickly, can we offer a temporary allocation from the burst pool in us-west-1 and cross-region route traffic? Need to check latency impact.
liam: What's the cost delta for burst vs reserved? Finance needs a rough number to pre-approve manual spend.
infra-bot: System: reservation-queue q-9f3b status=blocked reason="billing_hold" created=1958765400 ttl=48h
ryan: quick snippet I ran against the internal allocator to inspect the request:
```
# list queue entry
curl -sS https://internal-api.redwood/v1/alloc/queue/q-9f3b | jq .
```
ryan: The payload shows plan = "reserved", sku = "A100-80GB", region = "us-west-2", requested_by = "atlasai-prod"
billing-bot: Billing: Invoice INV-7891 is unpaid; auto-reserve will be blocked until settled. Opened ticket BT-452. Estimated hold clearance 24-72h depending on payment method.
maya: 36h window is tight. Sasha — can you measure p99 latency difference us-west-1 vs us-west-2 for their load profile? If <20ms we can route.
sasha: Running quick perf check on a representative sample — looks like cross-region adds +8-12ms median and p99 +18ms. Should be acceptable for their use-case (batch inference).
liam: Finance: provisional approval for up to $X/day extra cost to move to burst for 48h, pending formal ticket. Mark_finance, can you sign off?
mark_finance: I can approve a one-off carryover to unblock production, but we need a follow-up invoice/PO within 5 business days. Marking BT-452 as approved for emergency allocation.
ryan: OK — plan: 1) create a manual allocation from us-west-1 burst pool for 4xA100, attach IAM role for atlasai-prod, 2) update routing policy for that customer to us-west-1 for these instances, 3) track billing ticket for reconciliation. I'll run the allocator command now.
ryan: command used:
```
POST /v1/alloc/manual
{
  "alloc": "4x-A100-80GB",
  "pool": "burst-us-west-1",
  "owner": "atlasai-prod",
  "note": "manual emergency allocation due to billing hold in us-west-2 — BT-452"
}
```
ryan: Alloc created alloc-cc3a, instances provisioned, attaching network routes.
maya: Thanks. Sasha, please confirm service health after route flip and watch error budgets for the next 2 hours.
sasha: Service checks passing, initial traffic shift looks healthy. p99 latency stable within expected delta. No errors.
liam: Logging cost impact: estimated extra = ~$1.6k/day for burst vs reserved. Will tag charge to AtlasAI cost center for reconciliation.
mark_finance: Noted. Please include BT-452 reference on the invoice. Finance will process once payment/PO received.
maya: Great — I'll notify the customer and close this thread when BT-452 shows payment or we confirm reservation in us-west-2. Thanks all :thumbsup:
ryan: Filed follow-up reminder for 72h to move them back to reserved us-west-2 once billing clears (task #ops-alloc-137).
infra-bot: System: thread closed by maya at 1958765487
